acceptance: DOMAIN_NODE_KINDS and DOMAIN_NODE_KIND_SPECS include exactly the four new profile/quality/seed/synthetic kinds with closed deterministic field schemas while all previously qualified node kinds remain compatible.

SeedDataset and SyntheticDataset contracts make reproducibility, target environment, provenance, coverage, and verification intent explicit; SyntheticDataset additionally carries explicit privacy/schema-or-product constraint identity and must not imply copied private production values.
DataProfile and DataQualityRule contracts remain metadata only and cannot claim observations/rules were executed merely because nodes exist.

Focused tests prove valid examples plus missing-required, unknown-field, wrong-type, invalid privacy-class where reused, deterministic issue ordering, and full canonical domain-validation compatibility.

The exact implementation candidate passes repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline R2, checksum-verified Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution where applicable, Jev where actually available, exact-head CI, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused metadata-contract tests plus full repository format/lint/typecheck/test suites.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution, exact-head semantic review, Jev where available, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: The current Product Graph domain kind/spec validator is already the canonical metadata contract. A separate profiling or generation runtime in this Grain would duplicate authority and conflate representation with execution.

requirements: A profile or quality-rule node is evidence/requirement metadata, never proof that data was inspected or a rule was executed.
Seed/synthetic metadata never grants write authority and must not copy private production values by default.
Synthetic/seed reproducibility metadata is not permission to call a model, read a source, or write an environment.

outcome: The Product Graph can represent DataProfile, DataQualityRule, SeedDataset, and SyntheticDataset as closed deterministic metadata nodes with inspectable profile/quality evidence identity and reproducibility/privacy constraints, without profiling or generating data.
rationale: SG-000034 canonically established the four core Dataset identity/provenance nodes. The next bounded S07 slice adds the remaining non-relational V1 dataset metadata concepts before relation/cross-node semantics are introduced in a separate Grain.

risk.recovery: Revert the four profile/quality/seed/synthetic node-kind/spec additions, their focused tests, exports, and evidence; canonical dataset-core semantics through SG-000034 remain intact.

scope_in: Add closed Product Graph domain node kinds for DataProfile, DataQualityRule, SeedDataset, and SyntheticDataset through the existing deterministic domain validator.

DataProfile metadata must identify the dataset-version observation/provenance context and support inspectable statistics/quality characteristic references without claiming profiling execution occurred.
DataQualityRule metadata must express a deterministic, human-inspectable validity/reconciliation/integrity requirement without embedding executable code or granting mutation authority.

SeedDataset metadata must preserve deterministic/reproducible development/test intent, target environment identity, representative role/state/edge-case coverage references, provenance, and verification identity.

SyntheticDataset metadata must preserve schema/product-semantics and privacy-policy constraint references, deterministic/reproducible generation intent, target environment, provenance, coverage references, and verification identity.
Reuse the existing data-classification vocabulary where privacy classification is represented, and add focused deterministic validation tests while preserving all previously qualified domain kinds.
scope_out: No data profiling, statistics calculation, quality-rule execution, record generation, seed insertion, file/database/API read, persistence mutation, Supabase operation, model/provider call, network/secret access, production-data copying, or environment write.
No Dataset/DataProfile/DataQualityRule/SeedDataset/SyntheticDataset relation vocabulary or cross-node existence validation; relation semantics remain the next bounded S07 slice.
No VectorCorpus/EvalDataset AI-dataset semantics, no ProductCompletenessManifest, no P02-S06 endpoint repair, and no P03 work.
title: IN-P02-S07-T01B profile quality seed and synthetic semantic node contracts
